supplements.name: Astaxanthin

supplements.name: Tadalafil (Cialis)
supplements.notes: PDE5 inhibitor — relaxes blood vessels by boosting nitric oxide/cGMP signaling. Used for erectile dysfunction and enlarged prostate (BPH). Lowers blood pressure. Metabolized by CYP3A4, so anything that inhibits that enzyme raises tadalafil levels.

interactions.title: Extreme Bleeding Risk: Multiple Anticoagulant & Fibrinolytic Mechanisms
interactions.description: This stack layers multiple blood-thinning mechanisms: nattokinase (400 mg / 12,000 FU — fibrinolytic), serrapeptase (100 mg / 360,000 SPU — fibrinolytic), bromelain, krill oil (omega-3s), curcumin from THREE sources, black seed oil, trans-resveratrol (200 mg — antiplatelet), quercetin (50 mg — antiplatelet), and astaxanthin (mild antiplatelet). This is a dangerous compounding of anticoagulant/fibrinolytic mechanisms.
interactions.recommendation: This combination requires physician review. The stacking of nattokinase + serrapeptase + bromelain + curcumin + resveratrol creates serious hemorrhage risk. Physician must review before any surgery.

interactions.title: Vitamin D3 Toxicity Risk at 100,000 IU/day
interactions.description: 100,000 IU daily of D3 is far above the upper tolerable intake of 4,000 IU/day and even above the weekly bolus doses (50,000 IU/week) used therapeutically. This can cause hypercalcemia — dangerously high calcium levels leading to kidney stones, arterial calcification, nausea, confusion, and cardiac arrhythmias. While K2 helps direct calcium away from arteries, it cannot fully compensate for this level of D3. The multivitamin adds another ~800 IU.
interactions.recommendation: Require serum 25(OH)D and calcium levels. This dose should only be used short-term under medical supervision for documented severe deficiency.

interactions.title: Iodine Intake: Adequate but Monitor with Multivitamin
interactions.description: 300 mcg of iodine is about 2x the RDA (150 mcg) and well below the upper tolerable limit (1,100 mcg). The multivitamin adds additional iodine, so combined intake should be monitored to stay below the UL.
interactions.recommendation: Safe at this dose. Monitor total iodine intake from all supplements combined.

interactions.title: Zinc-Copper Imbalance (~119 mg Zinc)
interactions.description: Zinc from all sources: picolinate 100 mg + multi 7.5 mg + Snap Prostate 11 mg = ~119 mg total. This is 3x the upper tolerable limit (40 mg). Total copper is only ~3.65 mg (Thorne 2 mg + multi 0.75 mg + Snap 0.9 mg). The zinc:copper ratio is ~33:1 vs. the ideal 10-15:1. Chronic high zinc causes copper deficiency anemia and neurological damage.
interactions.recommendation: Reduce zinc to 30-50 mg/day total. At minimum, consolidate zinc sources and increase copper.

interactions.title: Tadalafil + Multiple BP-Lowering Agents: Hypotension Risk
interactions.description: Tadalafil (5 mg) is a vasodilator that lowers blood pressure by boosting nitric oxide/cGMP signaling. This stack ALSO contains: magnesium (vasodilator), potassium (counteracts sodium), olive leaf/oleuropein (ACE-inhibitor-like), beetroot (nitric oxide — same pathway as tadalafil), moringa (BP-lowering), and black seed oil (antihypertensive). Beetroot is especially concerning because it increases nitric oxide production through the same NO/cGMP pathway that tadalafil amplifies — this is additive vasodilation. Combined, these can cause dangerous drops in blood pressure, dizziness, fainting, and falls.
interactions.recommendation: Physician must know about ALL of these. Tadalafil + beetroot is the most concerning pair (same pathway). Monitor blood pressure sitting AND standing. Watch for dizziness when getting up quickly.

interactions.title: Multiple Mild Blood-Sugar-Lowering Agents
interactions.description: Several supplements have mild blood-sugar-lowering effects: moringa, black seed oil, chromium (40 mcg from multi), and ALCAR. Individually these are minor, but together they create a moderate glucose-lowering stack, especially when fasting or exercising.
interactions.recommendation: Low risk without the dedicated blood sugar formula and berberine. Monitor if diabetic or on glucose-lowering medication.

interactions.title: Boron Above Upper Tolerable Limit
interactions.description: 25 mg of boron exceeds the UL of 20 mg/day. The multivitamin adds another 1.2 mg. Total ~26.2 mg. While boron supports testosterone and bone metabolism, excess can cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and at very high doses, reproductive toxicity.
interactions.recommendation: Reduce to 3-10 mg/day unless directed by a physician.

interactions.title: Immune Stimulation from Multiple Sources
interactions.description: Several immune-stimulating compounds in the stack: elderberry and echinacea are immune activators, black seed oil is an immune modulator, L-lysine and vitamin C support immune function. For someone with autoimmune conditions, this level of immune stimulation could trigger or worsen flares. Echinacea is specifically cautioned in autoimmune disease.
interactions.recommendation: If there is any autoimmune history, consult an immunologist before continuing this combination.

interactions.title: Hormonal Stack Interactions (3 Products)
interactions.description: Testosterone/hormonal support from 3 products: Snap Prostate (saw palmetto, nettle, beta-sitosterol — DHT blocking), Himalayan Shilajit (tribulus, mucuna pruriens, ashwagandha, ginseng — testosterone boosting), and standalone boron (25 mg — raises free testosterone). DHT-blocking from Snap Prostate combined with testosterone-boosting from Shilajit creates opposing hormonal pressures. Mucuna pruriens raises dopamine which drives testosterone. Tribulus and ginseng are classic testosterone boosters.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor hormone levels (total/free testosterone, DHT, estradiol). Three overlapping hormonal products still means higher effective doses than any single label suggests.

interactions.title: Iron Absorption Blocked by Zinc, EGCG, and Minerals
interactions.description: The Codeage multi contains iron (27.5 mg). Zinc (~119 mg total), calcium, and magnesium all compete with iron for absorption. Green tea EGCG (in Snap Prostate, 45% of 500 mg antioxidant blend) is a potent iron absorption inhibitor. The combined mineral competition plus EGCG chelation may render the iron supplementation almost entirely ineffective.
interactions.recommendation: Take iron 2+ hours away from zinc, calcium, magnesium, and green tea. Or take iron with vitamin C to enhance absorption.

interactions.title: Piperine from 3 Sources Raises Tadalafil Levels
interactions.description: Tadalafil is metabolized by CYP3A4. Piperine from THREE products (turmeric blend, beetroot blend, NMN combo) inhibits CYP3A4, slowing the breakdown of tadalafil and raising its effective blood level. This means the 5 mg dose may act like a higher dose — increasing the risk of headaches, flushing, dangerously low blood pressure, and prolonged erections. Piperine also amplifies curcumin, resveratrol, and virtually everything else in this stack.
interactions.recommendation: The piperine load is effectively raising his tadalafil dose. His prescribing doctor needs to know about the piperine sources. Consider separating tadalafil dosing from piperine-containing supplements by several hours, though piperine's CYP3A4 inhibition can last 6+ hours.

interactions.title: Overlapping Olive Leaf Sources
interactions.description: Olive leaf extract appears as standalone (680 mg) and as concentrated oleuropein (50 mg). Both target the same pathway — oleuropein is just the active compound in olive leaf. Combined dose is moderate but redundant.
interactions.recommendation: Consider using one or the other rather than both.

interactions.title: Synergistic: D3 + K2 + Magnesium + Boron
interactions.description: This is a well-designed synergistic combination. K2 directs D3-mobilized calcium to bones and away from arteries. Magnesium is required for D3 metabolism (converts D3 to active 1,25-dihydroxy form). Boron reduces urinary calcium and magnesium loss. However, the D3 dose itself is the concern — the support stack is good.
interactions.recommendation: Good combination — just address the D3 dose.

interactions.title: Synergistic: Complete B-Vitamin Coverage
interactions.description: The standalone B vitamins (B1, B2, B3, B6, B12) plus those in the multivitamin provide thorough B-complex coverage. B vitamins work synergistically and are water-soluble (excess is excreted). Benfotiamine (B1) and P5P (B6) are superior bioavailable forms. Methylcobalamin (B12) is the active form. This is a well-constructed B-vitamin protocol.
interactions.recommendation: Good selection of forms. Monitor B6 total intake — keep under 100 mg/day long-term to avoid neuropathy.

interactions.title: Synergistic: Glutathione + Vitamin C
interactions.description: Vitamin C recycles oxidized glutathione back to its active reduced form. Liposomal glutathione has better absorption than standard. This is a solid antioxidant foundation.
interactions.recommendation: Good combination for antioxidant support.

interactions.title: Resveratrol + Curcumin + Piperine All Raise Tadalafil Levels
interactions.description: Trans-resveratrol (200 mg), curcumin (from multiple sources), and piperine (from 4 products) ALL inhibit CYP3A4 — the primary enzyme that breaks down tadalafil. This triple CYP3A4 blockade means tadalafil stays in the blood longer at higher concentrations. Tadalafil already has a 17.5-hour half-life; with CYP3A4 suppressed, it could effectively last much longer and reach higher peak levels.
interactions.recommendation: This is the most pharmacologically significant drug interaction in the stack. His doctor needs to know that multiple CYP3A4 inhibitors are being taken with tadalafil.

interactions.title: Magnesium from 4 Sources: ~219 mg Elemental
interactions.description: Magnesium from 4 sources: L-threonate (~144 mg elemental), glycinate (~50 mg), multi (15 mg), Snap Prostate (60 mg citrate, ~10 mg elemental). Total supplemental elemental Mg ~219 mg, within the 350 mg UL from supplements. Well-distributed across bioavailable forms.
interactions.recommendation: Spread magnesium doses throughout the day. Total is within safe range.

interactions.title: Trans Resveratrol 200 mg Adds to Antiplatelet Load
interactions.description: The NMN combo contains 200 mg of trans-resveratrol — a mild antiplatelet agent at this dose. Combined with nattokinase, serrapeptase, krill oil, and curcumin, it adds another antiplatelet mechanism to an already-loaded anticoagulant stack.
interactions.recommendation: The 200 mg resveratrol dose is lower than the 600 mg originally recorded, but still contributes antiplatelet activity to a stack that already has serious bleeding risk.

interactions.title: Vitamin D Now 101,000+ IU from Two Sources
interactions.description: The Sea Moss Gummies add 1,000 IU of Vitamin D3 on top of the existing 100,000 IU standalone dose and ~800 IU from the multivitamin. Total D3 is now over 101,800 IU/day — making an already dangerous overdose even higher.
interactions.recommendation: The additional 1,000 IU is trivial next to 100,000 IU, but it shows how supplements keep stacking without awareness of totals.

interactions.title: Shilajit's Hormonal Herbs Add to Prostate/Boron Stack
interactions.description: The Himalayan Shilajit product contains tribulus terrestris (testosterone booster), mucuna pruriens (dopamine/testosterone), ashwagandha (cortisol/testosterone), and Panax ginseng (hormonal adaptogen). Combined with Snap Prostate (saw palmetto, nettle — DHT blocking) and boron (25 mg — raises free testosterone), this is still 3 products manipulating hormones from multiple angles.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor testosterone, DHT, and estradiol. The combination is less extreme than before but still overlaps significantly.

interactions.title: Ashwagandha from 2 Sources + Adaptogens Lower BP Further
interactions.description: Ashwagandha appears in both the Shilajit product (40 mg) and Sea Moss Gummies. Ashwagandha lowers blood pressure and cortisol. Combined with Panax ginseng (from Shilajit) which also affects BP, plus tadalafil (vasodilator), potassium, olive leaf, beetroot, and magnesium, the hypotension risk is significant. Every additional BP-lowering agent on top of tadalafil increases the chance of dangerous drops.
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood pressure closely. With tadalafil in the stack, every BP-lowering supplement adds more risk.

interactions.title: Sea Moss Gummies Add More Immune Stimulants
interactions.description: The Sea Moss Gummies contain elderberry, black seed, turmeric, and moringa — all of which already appear as standalone supplements. This adds ANOTHER source of elderberry (now from 2 products), black seed (now from 2 products), turmeric (now from 3+ products), and moringa (now from 3+ products). The total immune stimulation load continues to climb.
interactions.recommendation: Serious redundancy. The gummies duplicate multiple ingredients already taken at much higher standalone doses.

interactions.title: Sea Moss Gummies Add 4th Source of Black Pepper
interactions.description: The Sea Moss Gummies contain black pepper, making it the 4th product with piperine (joining turmeric blend, beetroot blend, and NMN combo 5 mg). Each source amplifies absorption of everything else in the stack by inhibiting CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. The cumulative piperine dose makes effective doses of curcumin, resveratrol, and other compounds significantly higher than the labels suggest.
interactions.recommendation: Four sources of piperine means every other supplement in this stack has amplified, unpredictable absorption. This compounds every other interaction.

interactions.title: Shilajit + Sea Moss: Mild Glucose-Lowering Overlap
interactions.description: Shilajit lowers blood sugar mildly through fulvic acid. Sea moss gummies add turmeric, moringa, and ACV — all with mild glucose-lowering effects. Combined with standalone moringa (1,000 mg), these create a modest glucose-lowering background effect.
interactions.recommendation: Low risk without dedicated blood sugar supplements. Monitor glucose if diabetic or on medication.

interactions.title: CoQ10 from 2 Sources: ~25 mg Supplemental
interactions.description: CoQ10 from multivitamin (25 mg) and naturally in beef organs. Total supplemental CoQ10 ~25 mg plus dietary. This is a modest, safe level with mild cardiovascular support.
interactions.recommendation: CoQ10 at this level is beneficial. No concerns.

interactions.title: Rhodiola + Saffron: Serotonin & Dopamine Overlap
interactions.description: Rhodiola rosea increases serotonin and dopamine by inhibiting MAO enzymes. Saffron also affects serotonin reuptake (similar mechanism to SSRIs). Together they create a mild serotonergic combination. If combined with any antidepressant medication, there is a risk of serotonin syndrome — symptoms include agitation, rapid heartbeat, high temperature, and muscle twitching.
interactions.recommendation: Safe together at these doses for most people, but do NOT combine with SSRI/SNRI antidepressants without physician approval.

interactions.title: Synergistic: TMG + B12 + Folate Methylation Support
interactions.description: TMG (trimethylglycine) donates methyl groups to convert homocysteine to methionine. B12 and folate (from the multi) support the same pathway via a different route. Together they provide comprehensive methylation support — important for DNA repair, detox, and cardiovascular health. TMG also helps compensate for methyl group depletion from NAD/NMN supplementation.
interactions.recommendation: Good synergy, especially alongside the NAD supplement. The TMG dose is appropriate.

interactions.title: Synergistic: Astaxanthin + Glutathione + Vitamin C
interactions.description: Astaxanthin is one of the most potent antioxidants found in nature, working in both water- and fat-soluble environments. Combined with glutathione (the body's master antioxidant) and vitamin C (which recycles glutathione), this trio provides excellent multi-layer antioxidant protection.
interactions.recommendation: Strong antioxidant combination. Astaxanthin at 12 mg is a well-studied, safe dose.

interactions.title: Astaxanthin + Quercetin: Minor Antiplatelet Addition
interactions.description: Astaxanthin has mild antiplatelet effects. Quercetin (50 mg in the NMN combo) also mildly inhibits platelet aggregation. While individually minor, they add to a stack already containing krill oil, resveratrol (200 mg), nattokinase, serrapeptase, and curcumin.
interactions.recommendation: Individually safe. The antiplatelet contribution is minor compared to the nattokinase/serrapeptase/curcumin load.

interactions.title: Tadalafil + Beetroot: Double Nitric Oxide Pathway Activation
interactions.description: Tadalafil works by inhibiting PDE5, which preserves cGMP — the molecule that relaxes blood vessels after nitric oxide activates it. Beetroot provides dietary nitrates that convert to nitric oxide. Together, beetroot floods the system with extra NO while tadalafil prevents the signal from being broken down. This is additive vasodilation through the same pathway — like pressing the gas pedal (beetroot) while disabling the brakes (tadalafil). Can cause severe blood pressure drops, headaches, flushing, dizziness, and fainting.
interactions.recommendation: This is the single most dangerous supplement-drug pair in the stack. Separate dosing by several hours at minimum, or eliminate one. Doctor must be aware.

interactions.title: Tadalafil + Prostate/Hormonal Stack Overlap
interactions.description: Tadalafil at 5 mg daily is FDA-approved for both ED and BPH (enlarged prostate). Snap Prostate also targets prostate health via saw palmetto, nettle, and beta-sitosterol (DHT blockers). Boron raises free testosterone. Shilajit contains tribulus and mucuna pruriens (testosterone boosters). The combination creates overlapping prostate and hormonal interventions from both pharmaceutical and supplement angles.
interactions.recommendation: Not inherently dangerous, but the prescribing urologist should know about the supplement-based prostate and hormonal support to avoid over-treatment or masking of symptoms.

interactions.title: Tadalafil Adds Mild Antiplatelet Effect to Bleeding Stack
interactions.description: Tadalafil has a mild antiplatelet effect through the PDE5/cGMP pathway — it reduces platelet aggregation. While minor on its own, this adds yet another antiplatelet mechanism to a stack already containing nattokinase, serrapeptase, bromelain, krill oil, curcumin, resveratrol, and multiple other antiplatelet agents. The compounding of tadalafil's antiplatelet effect with this many other blood thinners further increases hemorrhage risk.
interactions.recommendation: The tadalafil contribution to bleeding risk is small compared to nattokinase/serrapeptase, but the prescribing doctor must know about the full anticoagulant stack.
